pack.heraliz_wonder.name: HeraliZ · Wonder Weapons (Zombies)
pack.heraliz_wonder.desc: Ray Gun, Mark II, Wunderwaffe DG-2, Thundergun, Jet Gun, Blundergat / Acid Gat, Winter's Howl, Sliquifier and Paralyzer for Zombies (with the heraliz_wonder mod).
heraliz_wonder.gun.raygun_bo6.name: Ray Gun
heraliz_wonder.gun.raygun_bo6.desc: Zombies wonder weapon: a green energy bolt that splashes on impact. Pack-a-Punch: Porter's X2 (red bolts).
heraliz_wonder.gun.ray_gun_mk2.name: Ray Gun Mark II
heraliz_wonder.gun.ray_gun_mk2.desc: Zombies wonder weapon: three-bolt bursts of piercing red energy. Pack-a-Punch: Mk II-Z (doubled bursts).
heraliz_wonder.gun.wonder_waffle.name: Wunderwaffe DG-2
heraliz_wonder.gun.wonder_waffle.desc: Zombies wonder weapon: lightning that leaps from zombie to zombie. Pack-a-Punch: Wunderwaffe DG-3 JZ.
heraliz_wonder.gun.thundergun.name: Thundergun
heraliz_wonder.gun.thundergun.desc: Zombies wonder weapon: a blast of compressed air that sweeps the horde away. Pack-a-Punch: Zeus Cannon.
heraliz_wonder.gun.jetgun.name: Jet Gun
heraliz_wonder.gun.jetgun.desc: Zombies wonder weapon: a hand-held jet engine that sucks the horde in and shreds it. Watch the heat gauge! Pack-a-Punch: reduced overheating.
heraliz_wonder.gun.blundergat.name: Blundergat
heraliz_wonder.gun.blundergat.desc: Zombies wonder weapon: a blunderbuss-Gatling that spits a spread of red-hot slugs, devastating up close. Pack-a-Punch: The Sweeper. Workbench: Acid Gat kit.
heraliz_wonder.gun.acidgat.name: Acid Gat
heraliz_wonder.gun.acidgat.desc: The Blundergat rebuilt with the workbench kit: three acid canisters that stick to zombies, then burst. Pack-a-Punch: Vitriolic Withering.
heraliz_wonder.gun.winters_howl.name: Winter's Howl
heraliz_wonder.gun.winters_howl.desc: Zombies wonder weapon: a blast of liquid nitrogen that slows, then freezes the horde solid; frozen zombies shatter. Pack-a-Punch: Winter's Fury.
heraliz_wonder.gun.sliquifier.name: Sliquifier
heraliz_wonder.gun.sliquifier.desc: Zombies wonder weapon: blobs of pink goo that liquefy zombies and leave slick puddles (zombies slip and melt, players slide fast). Pack-a-Punch: Sliquidator.
heraliz_wonder.gun.paralyzer.name: Paralyzer
heraliz_wonder.gun.paralyzer.desc: Zombies wonder weapon: a continuous beam that freezes zombies in place, then turns them to dust. Runs on charge: it comes back by itself, or faster by cranking (reload key); overheats when emptied. Aim at the ground under your feet to hover. Pack-a-Punch: Petrifier.
